title: Mailplate
description: A simple editor for creating minimalist email newsletter templates. Design clean, readable newsletters without the bloat.

title: Personal Website
description: A minimal, Swiss-style personal website built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, no build step.

title: Task CLI
description: A command-line task manager written in Go. Stores tasks in a local SQLite database with support for priorities, due dates, and tags.

title: Markdown Note Server
description: A lightweight HTTP server that serves a directory of Markdown files as a browsable wiki. Built with Node.js and zero dependencies.

title: Budget Tracker
description: A single-page budgeting app that stores data in localStorage. Tracks income, expenses, and recurring transactions with simple charts.

title: Git Stats
description: A Python script that analyzes a Git repository and generates a summary of commit frequency, contributor activity, and file churn.

title: DNS Lookup Tool
description: A terminal-based DNS lookup utility that supports A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, and TXT records. Written in Rust with colored output.

title: RSS Reader
description: A minimal RSS feed reader with a clean reading interface. Fetches and caches feeds locally, supports OPML import and export.

title: Image Resizer API
description: A small HTTP API that resizes and converts images on the fly. Accepts URL or file upload, returns optimized WebP or JPEG.

title: Pomodoro Timer
description: A distraction-free Pomodoro timer for the terminal. Tracks sessions, plays a bell sound, and logs completed work blocks to a CSV file.

title: Static Site Generator
description: A bare-bones static site generator that converts Markdown files into HTML pages using a single template. Under 300 lines of code.
